snippet.title: Kugle: Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Don’t miss the official trailer for Kugle a cosy gravity-platformer party game, playable cross-platform on smartphone and PC.
Play with your friends in a cute galaxy where gravity knows no bounds. Collect, care for, play with, breed, and trade colorful little creatures known as Kugles.

Kugle is available on PC (Epic Games Store) and Smartphone (Google Play & Apple Store).

Play now!

Official Site: https://kugle.app/
Epic Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/kugle-e7e6b3
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.KugleCorp.Kugle&hl=fr
